record.question: Which of the following are the Risk factors which are associated with Electronic Payment System?
options: Sending credit card details over internet
Remote storage of credit card details
record.explanation: Electronic-payment risks include fraudulent card use, exposure during transmission, and risks from storing card data remotely; all listed cases are valid risk factors. Evidence: https://www.pcisecuritystandards.org/document_library/ Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
